metadata.description: The webforai Agent Skill: read web pages and HTML files as clean, LLM-ready Markdown from coding agents.

plugins.name: webforai
plugins.description: Teaches the agent the webforai CLI: read any URL or HTML file as clean Markdown, batch-convert URLs, crawl a docs site into Markdown files and llms.txt, and handle JavaScript-heavy or bot-protected pages through the hosted API.
